# Terra Flow — Seamless Problem Solver

> A spatial thinking environment and philosophical problem-solving web platform combining Stoic wisdom with modern interactive flowchart visual reasoning.

## Core Capabilities
- [Main Flow Player](https://seamless-problem-solver.vercel.app/#player): Step-by-step interactive problem decomposition guided by ancient philosophical principles and decision trees.
- [Spatial Thinking Canvas Studio](https://seamless-problem-solver.vercel.app/#create): 60fps infinite spatial flowchart editor featuring 4-way direction sprout handles, spline wire physics, automated tree layout, and local JSON/PNG/SVG/Mermaid exports.
- [Three Pillars of Calm](https://seamless-problem-solver.vercel.app/#pillars): Interactive Dichotomy of Control sorter, 5-Minute Action micro-timer, and Amor Fati acceptance reflections.
- [Daily Multi-Philosopher Wisdom](https://seamless-problem-solver.vercel.app/#wisdom): Curated daily insights from Buddha, Hermes Trismegistus, Marcus Aurelius, Carl Jung, Leonardo da Vinci, Sri Aurobindo, and Rumi.
- [Contextual Visual AI Reasoning](https://seamless-problem-solver.vercel.app/#transmitter): Heuristic problem decomposition, edge-case generation, and micro-commitment breakdown.
